title: The Fall of the House of Vess

paragraphs.text: The Fall of the House of Vess is a Dominarian book that is an account of Liliana Vess 's failed attempt to save the life of Josu Vess . It is a commonly told tale around the Caligo Morass . Print copies of the book exist, and some feature an illustrator's interpretation of Liliana on the cover. Excerpts of the book were featured on cards in Dominaria and Masters 25 .
